title: I got something more like a couch
text: I got something more like a couch. I ordered for a chair!!!!!!!!  I got something more like a couch!  The directions suck!  Two of us could not figure this out.  We measured like it said before I ordered it.  It was just horrible!  BUT the material was great.  Maybe someone packaged the wrong item?  I just could not figure it out.  Just buyer be ware>>>>

product_metadata.title: Twill Ivory Furniture Slipcover Chair 399
description: One piece construction covers entire furniture, seat and back. Works on most furniture with square or rectangular seat cushion. Easy Fit slipcover is made to fit furniture with seat width from 20 to 24 inches when measured in between the arms and overall furniture circumference of maximum 135 inches. (Total of all four sides) of the furniture at widest point. Note: this slipcover will Not work with T shaped seat cushion. Twill Ivory fabric is made of upholstery grade durable twill fabric in Natural, solid color. Perfect slipcover choice, practically matches with any solid or printed patterns. This durable slipcover is perfect for high traffic areas and machine washable, 50% cotton, 50% poly
